items.text: in Safari a ring's slider (volume, flow) kept adding a tick each time you tapped its dot, its track shrank to the knob, and near the edge it ran off the screen: now one slider, full length, kept on screen
Safari no longer enlarges some words beside others (the cover's line "Free beta · v… · Pro testing", the slider's name)
on a ring, panel (the up arrow) always sits at the top, and back and next at the bottom left and right, as on the bar
the ring's middle is one row again: the pin on the left, the switch on the right, and the grip as small dots under the name. Drag the pin to move the ring; tap it to pin
a pin on the ring, under its switch. Pinned, the ring floats: the stage plays under it, a choice keeps it open, and the pin or Esc lets it go
the magnet's rec button no longer disappears while recording in the dark theme; it turns orange, like Steer's
the ring's magnet turns the magnet on, matching the magnet button in its drawer, and the ring shows magnet only while it pulls or pushes
a double-tap opens the ring while steering or moving the frame too
a switch on the ring stays a moment after you tap it, lit or unlit, so you can see it took
the first-discovery card names the path you were on (it said Path 01 whichever it was)
a path's number on its cards is the same round dot as on the bar
on the Play ring, back and next sit at the bottom, nearest the bar (back on the left, next on the right); volume takes the top, dice moves to the right
in the dice shelf, SEC, BEAT and BAR are set like PAIR beside them, no longer in large type
